verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-1 major finding is resolved. Section 3 now states the actual guarantee precisely: `_persist_one` can overwrite an in-window foreign edit, detects the suspect count shape only afterward, fails loudly without laundering the loss into success, and leaves the prior revision recoverable from issue history. The recommendation is correspondingly based on the proposed advisory ref mutex not excluding the only competing writer class that can reach this window, rather than on a false claim that the existing guard prevents overwrites. The record is internally consistent, appropriately bounds its unverified API claims, and changes no executable trust-plane behavior.
